eligibility.basis: Judged real sessions: judge-l2 (10 Oct 2026, 122 findings) and judge-l4 (12 Oct 2026, 87 findings). fragmented_edits 17 of 17 waste, repeated_exploration 10 of 10, regeneration: judge-l2 14 waste and 1 not waste (a rewrite under 30% repeated, no longer a finding); judge-l4 3 of 3 waste at 70% or more repeated, from one session, with 7 unsure rows at 52% to 64% repeated. Under the current rules none of the three has a judged false positive, but the 70% cut was set from the same judge-l4 rows it is judged on, so it is a proposal until another session confirms it.

advice.message: Claude is editing the same file in many small round trips. Asking it to plan the change and make it in one edit (or parallel edits) saves the extra turns.
Claude re-read a file, or re-ran a search, with no edit in between. The answer is already in its context; a note in CLAUDE.md to reuse earlier reads and search results avoids the repeat.
Claude rewrote a whole file that mostly repeats what was there. An in-place edit produces only the change and keeps the diff reviewable.
